root_cause.text: In the f2fs rename path, `f2fs_rename()` allocated an `fscrypt`/`f2fs_filename` via `f2fs_setup_filename()` for whiteout handling but failed to call `f2fs_free_filename()` afterward, causing a memory leak.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE and commit message explicitly state that commit `40b2d55e0452` "added a call to `f2fs_setup_filename()` without a matching call to `f2fs_free_filename()`", and the patch fixes `fs/f2fs/namei.c` by adding `f2fs_free_filename(&fname);` immediately after `f2fs_create_whiteout(idmap, old_dir, &whiteout, &fname);`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Free the temporary filename after whiteout creation in f2fs_rename() to avoid leaking filename resources on the rename path.
intent_record.what: A call to f2fs_free_filename(&fname) was inserted immediately after f2fs_create_whiteout(idmap, old_dir, &whiteout, &fname) and before checking whether err is nonzero in f2fs_rename().
intent_record.how: This ensures the filename resources stored in fname are released after attempting whiteout creation, regardless of whether f2fs_create_whiteout() succeeds or fails, preventing a resource leak during the rename path.

grouping_result.intent: Free the temporary filename after whiteout creation in f2fs_rename() to avoid leaking filename resources on the rename path.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly fixes the root cause: it adds freeing of the temporary fscrypt/f2fs filename in f2fs_rename() after whiteout handling, preventing the memory leak caused by missing f2fs_free_filename().

candidates.rationale: This call creates the whiteout using a temporary f2fs_filename/fscrypt filename object in fname, but on the pre-fix path there was no corresponding f2fs_free_filename() afterward, making this allocation site the direct origin of the leaked resource.

vuln_statements.explanation: This call passes a temporary f2fs_filename/fscrypt filename object via fname for whiteout creation in f2fs_rename(). In the pre-fix code path, the allocated filename resources were not released with f2fs_free_filename() afterward, causing the memory leak.

In this commit, under `if (flags & RENAME_WHITEOUT)`, the code newly declares `struct f2fs_filename fname;` and calls `err = f2fs_setup_filename(old_dir, &old_dentry->d_name, 0, &fname);` before passing `&fname` into `f2fs_create_whiteout(idmap, old_dir, &whiteout, &fname);`.
